mapper.select: SELECT outbox.id FROM alarm_notification_outbox outbox WHERE outbox.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY', 'PROCESSING') AND outbox.available_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alarm_history_v2 history INNER JOIN alarm_rule_v2 rule_v2 ON rule_v2.id = history.rule_id INNER JOIN alarm_template_item item ON item.id = rule_v2.template_item_id LEFT JOIN alarm_template header ON header.id = item.template_id WHERE history.id = outbox.history_id AND (item.deleted = 1 OR header.deleted = 1) ) ORDER BY outbox.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM alarm_notification_outbox WHERE claim_token = #{claimToken} AND status = 'PROCESSING' ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm_notification_outbox SET status = 'SENT', available_at = NULL, claim_token = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE alarm_notification_outbox SET status = 'RETRY', available_at = #{availableAt}, claim_token = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE alarm_notification_outbox SET status = 'DEAD', available_at = NULL, claim_token = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.delete: DELETE outbox FROM alarm_notification_outbox outbox INNER JOIN alarm_history_v2 history ON history.id = outbox.history_id WHERE history.rule_id = #{ruleId}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'SENT' THEN 1 END) AS sent, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'DEAD' THEN 1 END) AS dead FROM alarm_notification_outbox WHERE history_id = #{historyId}
